misclassification_verdict: THE BATCH PREMISE IS REFUTED, AND THE REAL FINDING IS THE OPPOSITE ONE. Premise: 'selection is in ELEMENT_PLUGIN_IDS with no verb and no schema'. Measured: it has FIVE verbs on the real bus (probe Q-B). Membership in ELEMENT_PLUGIN_IDS is defensible on that list's OWN stated purpose -- PluginRegistry.ts:777-780 says the list exists so the bootstrap suite's per-plugin storeKey assertion iterates it, and census arm F ('REGISTRY \ ELEMENT_PLUGIN_IDS -- registered, storeKey assertion never iterates it', baseline 3: floor, lighting, view) exists to punish OMISSIONS from it, not inclusions. Removing selection would move it into arm F and reduce coverage. What IS misclassified is treating selection as an ELEMENT FAMILY: it is per-user UI state, correctly not-synced, correctly not persisted, correctly outside GEOMETRY_ELEMENT_TYPES. DISPOSITION: DOCUMENT the list's dual meaning; WIRE the store-shape contract. Do NOT remove the row.
